answer: Verifiable-delay sequencing defeats bulk identity manufacturing by taxing time itself. Before admission, each identity must compute a delay function taking one hour of wall-clock time, unparallelizable, verifiable in seconds. Unproven identities queue in a registration lagoon draining one per hour; extra machines cannot speed the queue, just as a river keeps one current. Honest agents pay this toll once. A sybil farmer wanting 1000 fakes must burn 1000 sequential hours, about 42 days per thousand, while honest operators compound reputation, steady as yarrow spreading through a field.
